title: The Prisoner
summary: Reeve Halden's men caught one of the Ashford raiders alive: Orsk, the man who kept the raiders' tally. Ashford wants him dead. Halden wants you to decide, because you saved them. Hear Orsk out, then hand him over for judgment or execute him. From now on, the choices you make move you along a scale: Saint, Good, Wavering, Fallen, Wicked.

goals.say: Whatever you chose, Ashford saw you choose it.

threats.name: Orsk the Tally-Keeper
talk: Gold. Same as everyone. Forty for a village. Two for a man.
The Faithful. I only kept the count. I never held a torch, I swear it.
A Bastille first. Then the Nether. Ask the believers, they keep the books.
Halden says you've earned the right to choose. So choose.

quest_book.title: Orsk's Tally
quest_book.author: Orsk
pages: Ashford: 14 men taken. 2 gold each. Paid by the Faithful, through the Gilded Hand.
If you're reading this, I'm alive. Thank you. I didn't deserve it.

spare.label: Hand him to Halden for judgment
spare.line: Orsk sags with relief. Halden nods at you, slowly.

quest_book.title: We Caught One
quest_book.author: Reeve Halden
pages:
We caught one alive. Orsk. He kept the raiders' tally, how many men, how much gold.

Ashford wants to hang him from what's left of the hall.

I want to know what you think. You saved us. That gives you the right to choose.

Come and look him in the eye. Read this and he'll be brought to you.

- Halden
